rv.q: 'School Pictures' is at once entertaining, educational, thought provoking, vulnerable, hilarious, sentimental, and heart-warming.

cn.t: Critics praise this charming one-person song cycle for its poignant humor and inventive storytelling, finding it an extraordinary meditation on teaching that thoughtfully exposes inequities in education while remaining entertaining and deeply human.
